craft_notes: Sthāyin: assembly. Rows: arranged, remembered, cast. Read aloud: gathering.

lines: There, the worship-house with all gear replete arranged,
having brought to mind the blest Mālinī or Mother,
full of her-letter-splendour's mass, bearing the taken,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra sarvopakaraṇapūrṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vidhāya bhagavatīṃ mālinīṃ mātṛkāṃ vā smṛtvā tadvarṇatejaḥpuñjabharitaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhāvayan puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet
